description: dds<->dsterm version/capability handshake (FIXLIST #79). Pinned by BOTH repos: dsterm's status_contract_tests drives status_body() against this file, dds's dsterm_status_contract_test drives DstermDiscoveryInfo.fromJson against it. protocol_version is a STRING on the wire: shipped dds builds parse it with `as String?` and a numeric value would throw a TypeError there.
